boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 87 is a flood-drain puzzle with a heavy boss piece. Cyan `7` counter blocks fill the lower two-thirds of the board like a lake, while a green `15` boss block in an orange frame sits on the far left. A packed strip of colored blocks (orange, green `9`, red, blue, yellow) runs across the top and must clear first. Feed the green `15` boss through the left-wall exit, remove the small `3` counter blocks wedged between the cyan pieces, then let the cyan flood drain through the bottom.
landmarks: Block Out Level 87 is a flood-drain puzzle with a heavy boss piece.
Cyan `7` counter blocks fill the lower two-thirds of the board like a lake, while a green `15` boss block in an orange frame sits on the far left.
A packed strip of colored blocks (orange, green `9`, red, blue, yellow) runs across the top and must clear first.
Feed the green `15` boss through the left-wall exit, remove the small `3` counter blocks wedged between the cyan pieces, then let the cyan flood drain through the bottom.

quickTips: Start feeding the green `15` boss the moment the top strip clears — fifteen passes takes time and the lane must stay open.
Remove the red `3` and green `3` wedge blocks before trying to drain the cyan `7` flood.
The cyan flood drains on its own through the bottom exits once the wedge blocks are gone — do not try to push it.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the small orange block in the top-left upward through the top-exit arrow to open the first gap (02:55 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Push the yellow block on the right end of the top strip through the right-wall exit (02:50).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the red block through the top exit, then begin feeding the green `9` block upward — it needs nine passes (02:44–02:34).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Route the blue block through the right-wall exit once the green `9` block has thinned enough to free the lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: With the top strip clear, begin feeding the green `15` boss block through the left-wall exit — keep this lane permanently unblocked (02:28–02:13).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the small red `3` and green `3` blocks wedged between the cyan `7` pieces to ungate the drain path (around 02:18).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Let the cyan `7` flood drain through the bottom exits once the wedge blocks are gone (02:13–02:02).

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Finish with the last cyan fragments after the green `15` boss has fully exited (01:57).

failurePoints: Letting a stray block drift into the left-wall lane while feeding the green `15` boss — it stalls the longest feed in the level and forces you to waste moves re-clearing the lane.
Trying to drain the cyan `7` flood before removing the red `3` and green `3` wedge blocks — they dam the bottom exits and the flood cannot pass.
